_comment: The GoCommerce connector for Svelte Commerce, said once. version is npm's latest (npm view @misiki/gocommerce-connector version); scripts/verify.js fails when npm has moved on, and on any other version the site states. tested is what a full-stack run on testedOn showed working end to end; needsIdentity is what did not work there because GoCommerce ran without its identity module. Pages write {connectorVersion}, {connectorTested} and {connectorNeedsIdentity}, or read this file through src/lib/facts.ts.
tested: catalogue, cart, cash-on-delivery checkout and order lookup
needsIdentity: shopper sign-in, the address book and order history
